point.ranked_lists_compared_note: this arm recorded each item's ranked list, so fired/identical was a real element-wise comparison

repeat_check.note: LEGACY (not a determinism check): this run's `repeat` was compared on each item's TARGET RANK, and the point arm's target is selected to be lexically unreachable, so the rank is null in BOTH reads — `None == None` on every item, a constant no retrieval behaviour can move (`#13267` review 4 F2). It could not see a re-ordered window or a different id set, only a change in target PRESENCE. `repeat_identical` is therefore null here; the tool now compares per-side ranked-list digests and records this block itself.

construction.arm: point = the leg the expansion arms; object = the leg the published comparison measured
construction.keys_source: the target record's own salient tokens — the SHIPPED harvest's own shape (the pool is the linked points' search_keys), so the lift measured here is the mechanism's ceiling under a clean key set

construction_unrecorded.note: this run predates the tool recording these knobs, so they are NOT evidence here — the values it ran with are prose in research-brief.md §3 and §8 (headline: query-chars default 500, read window 30; short-query arm: query-chars 200, read window 60; key-tokens 4, min-query-tokens 3). ⛔ The two point arms differ in BOTH `query_chars` and `read_limit`, so the robustness arm's difference cannot be attributed to the query cap alone (#13267 F5). The tool records `construction.query_chars`/`key_tokens`/`min_query_tokens` from this version onward.

environment.same_load_note: both arms ran back to back in ONE process on ONE box, so the loads below bracket the whole comparison rather than one arm — and the delta is reported so a reader can see whether the box moved under it

items.id_digest_note: sha256 over the synthetic `item-NNNNNN` ids every draw assigns — a function of the sample SIZE only, NOT pairing evidence; use name_digest

pairing.same_item_list_is_structural: one `items` list is built once and handed to every arm in the same process, so a different sample per arm is not reachable; `items.name_digest` (and `population.names_sha256`) is the discriminating record of WHICH names those items came from. `items.id_digest` is NOT: it digests the synthetic `item-NNNNNN` ids, so it is a function of the sample SIZE only (#13267 F6).

provenance.git_head_note: `git_head` is the repo commit the run sat on, and it does NOT identify the producing code: ALL THREE artifacts carry the `mde_note` key, and the object control's is populated and sits beside a `nan` `mde_paired` (the two point artifacts' `mde_note` is `""` and their `mde_paired` is finite) — the tool emits that key only from 5898385f2e onward, and that fix was UNCOMMITTED when the run happened. `tool_sha256` is null because this run predates the field; a run from this tool version records the digest of its own bytes and whether they were committed (#13267 F4).
